// Generator for go_state.db / go_state.expected.json (kept as .txt so it never
// becomes part of the Go module). To regenerate: copy it to
// internal/adapters/sqlite/zzgen/main.go, run
//   go run ./internal/adapters/sqlite/zzgen <out-dir>
// from the repo root, then delete the directory again.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/xean-io/rocket/internal/adapters/sqlite"
	"github.com/xean-io/rocket/internal/domain"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	dbPath := filepath.Join(out, "go_state.db")
	_ = os.Remove(dbPath)
	s, err := sqlite.Open(dbPath)
	must(err)

	base := time.Date(2026, 3, 14, 9, 26, 53, 589793238, time.UTC)
	must(s.UpsertProject(domain.ProjectRef{Name: "nuvara", Path: "/code/nuvara", AddedAt: base}))
	must(s.UpsertProject(domain.ProjectRef{Name: "alpha", Path: "/code/alpha", AddedAt: base.Add(-time.Hour).Truncate(time.Second)}))
	must(s.UpsertProject(domain.ProjectRef{Name: "half", Path: "/code/half", AddedAt: base.Truncate(time.Second).Add(500 * time.Millisecond)}))

	exp := base.Add(time.Minute)
	started := base
	stopped := base.Add(2 * time.Minute)
	code := 137
	must(s.SaveRun(domain.Run{Project: "nuvara", Service: "api", Env: "dev", Kind: domain.KindRun, State: domain.StateRunning,
		Health: domain.HealthHealthy, PID: 4242, PGID: 4242, Owner: "agent:claude", ExpiresAt: &exp, StartedAt: &started,
		Ports: map[string]int{"http": 3100, "debug": 9229}, LogPath: "/logs/nuvara/api.log"}))
	must(s.SaveRun(domain.Run{Project: "nuvara", Service: "db", Env: "dev", Kind: domain.KindCompose, State: domain.StateStopped,
		Health: domain.HealthUnknown, ComposeProject: "rocket-nuvara-dev", Profiles: []string{"base", "extra"}, ContainerID: "abc123",
		StoppedAt: &stopped, ExitCode: &code, Error: "boom \"quoted\" <tag> & ünï"}))
	must(s.SaveRun(domain.Run{Project: "alpha", Service: "web", Kind: domain.KindTask, State: domain.StateFailed, Health: domain.HealthUnhealthy}))

	must(s.AcquireLease(domain.Lease{Port: 3100, Project: "nuvara", Service: "api", PortName: "http", CreatedAt: base}))
	must(s.AcquireLease(domain.Lease{Port: 9229, Project: "nuvara", Service: "api", PortName: "debug", CreatedAt: base.Truncate(time.Second)}))
	must(s.AcquireLease(domain.Lease{Port: 5432, Project: "nuvara", Service: "db", PortName: "pg", CreatedAt: base.Add(time.Millisecond)}))

	code3 := 3
	deadline := base.Add(30 * time.Minute)
	fin := base.Add(5 * time.Second)
	jobs := []domain.Job{
		{ID: "j1", Project: "nuvara", Name: "ci", Kind: domain.JobPipeline, Env: "dev", Owner: "user", Status: domain.JobFailed,
			Profiles: []string{"base"}, Steps: []domain.Step{{Task: "lint"}, {Run: "go test ./..."}}, Args: []string{"-v", "--race"},
			Step: 2, PID: 77, PGID: 77, ExitCode: &code3, StartedAt: base, ExpiresAt: &deadline, FinishedAt: &fin, DurationMS: 5000,
			LogPath: "/l/j1.log", Error: "step 2 failed"},
		{ID: "j2", Project: "nuvara", Name: "setup", Kind: domain.JobSetup, Owner: "agent:x", Status: domain.JobRunning,
			Steps: []domain.Step{{Run: "make deps"}}, StartedAt: base.Add(500 * time.Millisecond)},
		{ID: "j3", Project: "alpha", Name: "prod", Kind: domain.JobDeploy, Env: "prod", Owner: "user", Status: domain.JobSucceeded,
			StartedAt: base.Add(time.Second).Truncate(time.Second), LogPath: "/l/j3.log"},
	}
	for _, j := range jobs {
		must(s.SaveJob(j))
	}
	must(s.Close())

	// Expected values, read back through the Go adapter and re-encoded.
	s, err = sqlite.Open(dbPath)
	must(err)
	defer s.Close()
	projects, err := s.ListProjects()
	must(err)
	runs, err := s.ListRuns()
	must(err)
	leases, err := s.ListLeases()
	must(err)
	allJobs, err := s.ListJobs("", 0)
	must(err)
	nuvaraJobs, err := s.ListJobs("nuvara", 1)
	must(err)
	expected := map[string]any{"projects": projects, "runs": runs, "leases": leases, "jobs": allJobs, "jobs_nuvara_limit1": nuvaraJobs}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(expected, "", "  ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "go_state.expected.json"), data, 0o644))
}
